title: TypeAndQuantityNode
description: A structured value indicating the quantity, unit of measurement, and business function of goods included in a bundle offer.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

amountOfThisGood.title: Amount Of This Good
amountOfThisGood.description: The quantity of the goods included in the offer.

businessFunction.title: Business Function
businessFunction.description: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.

typeOfGood.title: Type Of Good
typeOfGood.description: The product that this structured value is referring to.

unitCode.title: Unit Code
unitCode.description: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code (3 characters) or a URL. Other codes than the UN/CEFACT Common Code may be used with a prefix followed by a colon.

unitText.title: Unit Text
unitText.description: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement. Useful if you cannot provide a standard unit code for unitCode.
